affine_pencil: Writing the determinant matrix as A(X,u)+Z B(X,u), A has rows [Xu-a,2b] and [2(X+u),Xu-a], while B has rows [X+u,2Xu] and [2,X+u].
commutator: The exact commutator [A,B] is diagonal with entries delta and -delta, where delta=4(b-Xu(X+u)). Hence M(z1)M(z2)-M(z2)M(z1) =(z2-z1)[A,B], and the naive root-matrix product is generically order sensitive rather than a symmetric function of the roots of U.
discriminant: The discriminant of S3(X,Z,u) as a quadratic in Z is 16(X^3+aX+b)(u^3+au+b). On the two compact curve divisors its square root is 4 V(X) V_T(u); diagonalizing the pencil therefore recovers the two target-sign branches already exposed in R172.
elementary_symmetric_identity: For s1=X+Z+u, s2=XZ+Xu+Zu, and s3=XZu, S3(X,Z,u) =(s2-a)^2-4*s1*(s3+b). This is the determinant of the 2 by 2 matrix [[s2-a,2(s3+b)],[2s1,s2-a]].
